about_the_game:
Aokigahara: The Death Forest

Can you survive the horrors of the Suicide Forest?

Deep in Japan, where the dense Aokigahara forest stretches endlessly, shadows weave untold stories of fear and despair.

Alone in this forgotten place, the line between reality and nightmare begins to blur, while the whispers of the dead echo among the twisted trees.

Aokigahara: The Death Forest plunges you into the heart of psychological horror, where every step, every breath, and every decision is a fight for survival.

Explore in Absolute Darkness

  • Roam the depths of Aokigahara, where the only light is the one you carry.

  • (Planned feature) Discover mysterious caves and ancient shrines, each hiding terrifying secrets.

Psychological Horror & Hallucinations (Planned feature)

  • Watch as your perception distorts and paranoia takes hold.

  • Uncover the truth behind the eerie whispers, lurking figures, and shifting shadows.

Survival is Not Guaranteed (Some features under development)

  • Solve intricate puzzles to unlock the forest’s mysteries and find a way out. (Planned feature)

  • Use your limited tools wisely—your survival depends on it.

  • Hide, move silently, and stay on edge… because you are not alone.

A Fully Immersive Experience

  • Dynamic lighting and subtle fog enhance the atmosphere of dread.

  • 3D sound effects create an unsettling sense of presence.

  • Inspired by ancient Japanese folklore about Aokigahara, adding chilling realism to the experience.

Will you uncover the forest’s secrets, or become part of its haunting legend?
